messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Alert — inference-serving (us-east-1) degraded since 2026-03-15T02:24:16Z. 502 errors increased to 6.8% and p95 latency spiked to 1.8s. Paging on-call.

Mike C: seeing it, joining. quick check: are any dedicated pools impacted or just hosted?

Kelsey R: looks like hosted API only, dedicated pools show normal throughput. root cause unknown, rolling back recent routing change now.

Mike C: thx. Kelsey, if rollback doesn't recover in 10m we'll take traffic off the routing layer to force failover to standby model variants. keep me posted.

Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03015-01 — High error rate, customer-facing. Status page draft: "Degraded performance in US-East affecting text generation; investigating." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-03015-01

Jordana S: tagging Billing + CS: we need an SLA eligibility check once we have duration and affected customer list. Please hold any outbound invoices for impacted customers until we confirm.

Billing: noted. please provide affected customer IDs and window. we will queue a potential adjustment request.

SRE Lead: rollback applied at 02:33:02Z — metrics trending down but still above normal. rolling deploy of routing-controller 1.4.7 -> 1.4.6 in progress.

Kelsey R: partial recovery at 02:38:40Z; full recovery at 02:44:11Z per tracing. root cause appears to be a mismatched kernel selection in the routing controller under burst load; will follow up with postmortem.

Mike C: timeline for impact window: 2026-03-15T02:24:16Z -> 2026-03-15T02:44:11Z (00:19:55). Need definitive list of customers who experienced errors vs latency-only.

Oncall Bot: Affected requests: 2.3% of total requests in window returned 502s. Top impacted customers by volume: cust-7542, cust-2381, cust-9910.

Ava (CS): FYI — cust-7542 is on an enterprise SLA (99.9% monthly). They started an open ticket at 02:30 and are asking for an incident summary. We should prepare a credit estimate and a short customer message.

Mike C: Billing — please run SLA credit calculation for cust-7542 given 19m55s impact. SLA is 99.9% monthly uptime. Include formula used.

Billing: working on it. quick calc note: 99.9% monthly allowance = ~43.2 minutes downtime allowed per 30-day period (30*24*60 = 43200 mins -> 0.1% = 43.2 mins). Impact window 19.92 mins. Pro-rated credit depends on contract terms. If contract has "credit = (downtime - SLA_allowance)/month * monthly_fee", need monthly_fee from finance.

Jordana S: here's a draft public-facing status update for the status page and to copy into customer message. please review: 

```
Status update (2026-03-15 02:50 UTC):
We experienced degraded performance and increased errors for the inference-hosted API in the US-East region between 02:24 and 02:44 UTC. A routing configuration change caused some requests to be routed to an incompatible kernel path under burst load. We have rolled back the change and service is restored. No data loss detected. A post-incident report will follow.
```

SRE Lead: small tweak: call out exact time to seconds and note which model routes were affected (text-generation-v2 variants). otherwise LGTM.

Ava (CS): customer-facing email draft for cust-7542 below. Billing & Legal please review before sending.

```
Hi <Customer Name>,

We're writing about an incident that impacted Redwood's hosted inference in US-East on 15 March 2026. Between 02:24:16 UTC and 02:44:11 UTC we observed increased errors and latency for some requests to text-generation endpoints. Our team identified a routing configuration change that caused a mismatch in kernel selection under burst traffic; the change was rolled back and full service was restored at 02:44:11 UTC. We confirmed no data loss. 

We estimate the interruption lasted ~19 minutes and 55 seconds. Per your SLA (99.9% monthly uptime), Redwood is reviewing eligibility for service credits. We will follow up with a credit estimate and any next steps by EOD. We apologize for the disruption and are taking steps to prevent recurrence (postmortem and safer rollout guardrails).

Best,
Redwood Incident Response
```

Billing: to proceed we need: (1) contract monthly_fee for cust-7542, (2) whether their SLA has a hard allowance clause (some enterprise contracts exclude first 30 mins), (3) decision on goodwill vs formal credit.

Finance (cc): can you confirm monthly_fee for cust-7542? tagging @finance on the thread.

Mike C: also need precise metric-backed impact: number of failed requests and percent of their traffic impacted. SRE: can you export a CSV of request-level hits for those customer tokens between 02:20-02:50? attach to INC ticket.

SRE Lead: exporting now. attaching to INC-2026-03015-01: /incidents/INC-2026-03015-01/artifacts/requests_cust-7542_20260315.csv (will add to ticket).

Jordana S: once we have the data, Billing please prepare two proposals: (A) formal SLA credit calculation with contract terms applied, (B) a goodwill credit offer (smaller, quicker) if customer prefers. We'll coordinate CS outreach.

Billing: will prepare both. estimated turnaround 2 hours.

Ava (CS): I'll hold off on sending initial email until Billing confirms numbers. If Finance confirms monthly_fee, I'll propose the goodwill option first and mention that a formal credit is being processed.

Oncall Bot: Note: this thread will be appended to the incident timeline and used in the postmortem. React with :white_check_mark: when you've completed assigned actions.

Mike C: quick postmortem items: (1) add rollout validation to routing-controller deploys, (2) add automatic rollback threshold for kernel MISMATCH errors, (3) add canary traffic spike test. Assigning SRE to own these.

SRE Lead: will create tasks and PRs.

Billing: updating queue — will post calculations in this thread and file a billing adjustment ticket if credit is due.

Ava (CS): thanks all. keeping cust-7542 updated with high level note: "we're investigating and will follow up with credit estimate."

Mike C: good. close the loop here once Billing posts figures and Finance confirms monthly_fee.

Oncall Bot: Incident closed (service restored) at 2026-03-15T02:44:11Z. Final status will be published after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
